newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades Guardian Life ratings.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades Guardian Life ratings.

text.p: A.M. Best said Friday it lowered its ratings on Guardian Life Insurance Co and Guardian Insurance & Annuity Co Inc, both of New York, to "A+" (Superior) from "A++" (Superior).

A.M. Best said the move reflects the company's difficulty in re-establishing sales momentum and sustaining productivity in its life segment, especially in light of reduced demand for life insurance products.
The move also acknowledges the competitive pressure faced by the company as it continues to shift its group medical line toward becoming a regional provider of managed care, A.M. Best said.

A.M. Best said it believes the company's superior capitalization gives it flexibility in reinvigorating its individual life and non-medical group insurance operations while continuing to build a more prominent presence in its equity and pension businesses.
A.M. Best said the Superior rating reflects the company's capitalization, the high quality of its investment portfolio and its conservative operating strategy.
